title: Nut Crust
ldlActiveSummary: Nuts and unsaturated fats replace traditional butter-based pastry crusts.
intro: Cultural Note and Regional Roots: Nut-based crusts have long been used as gluten-free alternatives to traditional pastry and cookie crusts. Pecans and pistachios provide rich flavor, sturdy texture, and naturally occurring unsaturated fats that pair well with fruit, citrus, cream-style, and custard desserts while avoiding refined flour and butter.

stepGroups.title: Toast and Grind
items: Toast the {{quantity:pecans}} pecan halves and {{quantity:pistachios}} shelled pistachios for 8 minutes until fragrant. Cool completely.
Pulse the toasted {{quantity:pecans}} pecan halves and {{quantity:pistachios}} shelled pistachios in a food processor until coarse crumbs form.

stepGroups.title: Build the Crust
items: Add the {{quantity:date-sugar}} date sugar and {{quantity:kosher-salt}} kosher salt to the food processor and pulse to combine.
Add the {{quantity:avocado-oil}} avocado oil and the {{quantity:egg-white}} large egg white. Pulse until the mixture resembles damp sand and holds together when squeezed.

stepGroups.title: Bake
items: Press the nut mixture firmly into the bottom and sides of a 9-inch pie plate.
Bake the crust for 10 to 12 minutes until lightly golden and fragrant.
Cool completely before filling with the desired pie filling.
